# Vendored third-party assets

Everything the admin UI and the API explorer (`/api/docs`) load from outside this
repository lives here, compiled into the binary, so the UI works on a network
with no internet access (#271). Nothing in this directory is edited by hand.

Every file name carries its upstream version, and `/static/vendor/*` is served
with `Cache-Control: immutable`. An upgrade is therefore a **new file name**:
update the `<script>`/`<link>` tags and the `VENDOR_FILES` table in
`crates/cli/src/server/web.rs`. A unit test there fails if the table and this
directory disagree.

| File | Upstream | Source | SHA-256 | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|---|

| `lucide-0.469.0.min.js` | lucide 0.469.0 | npm tarball, `dist/umd/lucide.min.js` | `5de4fffddc1b41ad1226d5e986fcc552adb8ad9efd1566e71dfdcdb664f9a6c2` | ISC |

## Reproducing a file

npm packages: fetch the tarball the registry lists, check it against the
registry's `dist.integrity`, and extract the file named in the table:

```sh
meta=$(curl -sf https://registry.npmjs.org/lucide/0.469.0)
url=$(echo "$meta" | jq -r .dist.tarball)
integrity=$(echo "$meta" | jq -r .dist.integrity)
curl -sf -o pkg.tgz "$url"
[ "sha512-$(openssl dgst -sha512 -binary pkg.tgz | base64 -w0)" = "$integrity" ] && tar -xzf pkg.tgz
sha256sum package/dist/umd/lucide.min.js
```

Inter: request the stylesheet the UI used to `@import` with a modern browser
User-Agent (`-A 'Mozilla/5.0 … Chrome/130.0 …'`) to get the woff2 variant:
`https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800&display=swap`.
It lists one file per subset, repeated for each weight, because the font is
variable. `inter-v20/inter.css` keeps one rule per subset, with `font-weight: 300 800`.

The JS files keep their trailing `//# sourceMappingURL=` comment, so they stay
byte-identical to upstream. The `.map` files are not shipped; with DevTools
open, the browser logs a harmless 404 for them.
